seed: The Pen used to keep itself in hand after a shape landed, which made it the one drawing tool in the app that did not hand back the pointer. The user hit it twice, the second time as "after i create a shape, it doesn't select it and switch to V tool". This walk holds the new ending: a finished path leaves you on Select with that path picked, so the arrow keys move it straight away, and P starts the next shape. Five shapes cost five presses of P, one per shape, which is exactly what five rectangles already cost in presses of R.

steps.note: the triangle landed and the POINTER is back, with the new path picked: the same ending a rectangle, a line, a measure and a frame all have

THE TEST. Three presses of the right arrow straight after drawing, with no tool change in between, and then one undo. Two layers still: the undo took back a NUDGE, which means the arrow keys were acting on the shape. Before this change they were acting on nothing at all, and that one undo would have taken the triangle instead

steps.contains: Drag a point to reshape this shape

steps.note: P over a path that is already picked KEEPS the pick, so its points are there to grab: picking up the Pen is how you reach the anchors of a finished shape, and the hand-back did not take that away

a press away from the points starts the next shape and lets the last one go: drawing is not editing, and a shape still picked is a shape a stray Backspace can take off the canvas behind the line you are drawing
Backspace mid-path takes back ONE anchor, the same step Command Z takes, and the finished triangle is untouched: still two layers
two shapes for two presses of P, and the second lands picked with the pointer in hand like the first. A five shape icon costs five presses of P, which is what the other ten drawing tools already cost

one undo takes back the whole second shape, however many anchors went into it, AND puts the selection back to the nothing that was picked before it: undo does not leave the panels describing a layer that is no longer there
redo puts the shape back and puts it back picked, so the step after a redo is the work rather than a re-pick
Escape with nothing being drawn still puts the Pen down, which is the way out for a Pen picked up and not used
V still puts the Pen down mid-path, exactly as it always did, and the two anchors that were on screen were never in the document, so nothing was added and there is nothing to undo

the second anchor of a short edge arrives as a DOUBLE click, because it is a click close to the last one in space and time. It has to land as an anchor: the window used to take it and zoom itself instead, so the shape came out with one corner missing. Three anchors here is the proof it landed
